decision: Implement explicit Python source/value serialization profile in the same Rust parser/writer kernel; do not qualify away accepted predecessor capabilities.

basis.contract: CONTRACT-080 no silent meaning loss, existing accepted capabilities, source/output-only resource limits

api.read: serialization::read_python_value(source: &PyText, format: Format, ctx: &mut Context) -> Result<PythonConsumerValue, EngineError>
api.write: serialization::write_python_value(value: &PythonConsumerValue, format: Format, ctx: &mut Context) -> Result<PyText, EngineError>
api.ownership: Shared Rust parser/writer implementation with explicit profile/value-builder/text-view adaptation; no Python semantic reader/writer, no duplicate independent parser/evaluator. Typed PyO3 converts exact native strings/values only. Host selects profile explicitly; source data cannot select callbacks or execution.

requiredSemantics: Default shared ECMAScript/Bun value and source profile remains unchanged.
Python JSON raw codepoints distinguish astral scalar, explicit surrogate pair and isolated surrogate; JSON adjacent escaped high/low surrogate pair combines exactly as predecessor json.loads.
Python YAML native resolver admits signed hexadecimal/octal and underscores as predecessor numbers; legacy binary refusal is retained unless separately reviewed.
Preserve Python int versus float source/value origin within unchanged safe finite ordinary numeric envelope. Consumer-schema arbitrary-instance number profile is separate.

Preserve Python dictionary codepoint key identity and duplicate checks, including integer-looking keys and dual keys sharing UTF16 units. JSON read/write and YAML read preserve source/dict insertion order; YAML write sorts every mapping recursively by Python Unicode-codepoint lexicographic key order. See explicit amendment R2-SOL-PYTHON-SERIALIZATION-001-A1.
Python writer returns PyText and round-trips native string/key/int/float identity. Quote strings that its own resolver would otherwise reinterpret, including 1_000 and signed radix spellings.
YAML escaped surrogate pairs remain two Python codepoints where predecessor does; raw YAML invalid codepoints remain refused under the Python profile.

Source/output ceiling remains frozen4M UTF16 units. The former Python codepoint-count ceiling difference is already an explicit governing resource decision; copied native fields/intermediates do not receive4M caps.
Use caller Context for premeasurement, admission, allocation/copy, enumeration and output conversion. HardIsolated refuses before conversion or parsing.
qualification: Execute frozen62 native predecessor cases on installed typed Python APIs; exact value/type/codepoint/key-order and accepted/refused outcomes.
Execute native Rust and actual distributed WASM with explicit Python profile if exposed in that distribution; default139/current source profile remains green.
Writer whitespace bytes are not required equal; semantic value/type/codepoint identity is required. Original compiler eleven output bytes remain independently frozen.
Do not alter predecessor fixtures to match candidate results; add explicit reviewed corrections separately.
